captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a classic Civil War field cannon. It features a long, tapered cast-iron barrel in dark gray/black, complete with a rear cascabel and cylindrical trunnions. The barrel is mounted on a brown wooden carriage assembly consisting of two side trails, crossbeams, and a rear trail tip. Two large wooden spoked wheels with dark metal rims are mounted on a central axle, allowing them to spin, while the barrel can pivot vertically on its trunnions.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a Civil War field cannon with a dark cast iron barrel mounted on a wooden carriage with two spoked wheels. The barrel should have a revolute joint to elevate, and the wheels should have continuous or revolute joints to rotate on their axle.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-part articulated assembly consisting of a carriage base, a barrel, and two wheels. The carriage base is built using rectangular boxes for the side trails, crossbeams, and axle supports. The barrel is modeled using a series of cylinders and cones to create the tapered muzzle, cascabel, and cylindrical trunnion pins. The spoked wheels are generated by patterning radial cylinders (spokes) between a central hub and an outer rim. These components are connected via revolute joints (for the barrel elevation and wheel rotation) defined with precise spatial origins and rotation axes.
